source.changes: Names and page references adapted into Edda planning metadata; no rules prose or numeric catalogue imported.

issues.title: Track two Shield of Faith casters with independent recipient effects
issues.fixture: Two explicitly prepared level-one Clerics cast Shield of Faith at separate times on one known creature within 60 feet, then one caster ends concentration.
issues.targets: One known same-campaign creature per cast; retain the existing conscious-self path. Require authoritative range and clear path; reject unknown range, total cover, foreign or hidden recipients.
issues.cost: Each cast: one level-one slot, Bonus Action, V/S and noncostly material/focus availability; one-slot-per-turn limit. Voluntary ending: no action or slot refund.
issues.timing: Absolute start/expiry seconds, maximum 600 seconds. Replace only the casting caster’s previous concentration. Equal-potency overlapping +2 AC applies once, latest casting active; ending it reveals an older still-live effect without restarting its clock.
accept: Persist cast identity separately from recipient links; remove all links only for the ended cast. Different casters never overwrite each other. Preserve old self-only saves and unrelated stats.

Prove same caster replacement, different caster overlap, equal potency tie, exact expiry, older effect resumption, independent targets and no doubled AC. Different spell AC terms retain their own rules.
issues.exclusions: No arbitrary potency comparator, Bless, multiple targets per cast, item activation, new character creation, or blanket spell support.

issues.title: Apply one level-one Bless cast to up to three explicit recipients
issues.fixture: One prepared level-one Cleric casts Bless on self and two known creatures; one recipient makes a supported attack and another makes a supported saving throw.
issues.targets: One to three distinct known same-campaign creatures within 30 feet and a clear path. Validate every target before any write. No hidden actor enumeration.
issues.cost: One level-one slot and Magic action, V/S and an owned Holy Symbol worth at least 5 GP (not consumed). Verify the explicit priced material; an arbitrary focus cannot substitute for it. A d4 per affected attack roll or saving throw, no cost per recipient.
issues.timing: Concentration up to 60 seconds; one cast identity owns all recipient links. Overlapping equal Bless casts give one d4, latest live effect; caster ending removes only that cast.
accept: Apply recorded d4 to supported attacks and saves only, including concentration Constitution saves; never ability checks, damage rolls or repeated preview.

Reject duplicate, fourth, foreign, hidden, out-of-range, total-cover or stale targets atomically. Test each recipient reload, caster replacement and ending, overlapping caster expiry and no stacked d4.
issues.exclusions: No upcasting, Bane, general ally AI, arbitrary NPC turns, advancement or spell-list expansion.

issues.title: End the exact concentration cast on resolved damage and incapacitation events
issues.fixture: A concentrating Cleric has two recorded independent damage sources, then a trusted Unconscious transition at positive HP; all recipient links end on failed save or incapacitation.
issues.targets: The authoritative damaged/conditioned caster and only that caster’s effect recipients. Consume server-resolved events, never client-declared damage or condition flags.
issues.cost: No action, spell slot, or recovery. One Constitution save per separate positive damage source while still concentrating; no save on incapacitation, death or zero-HP ending.
issues.timing: Within the damage/condition transaction, before further use of the ended effect. DC min(30,max(10,floor(actual damage/2))). No check for zero damage or already-ended concentration.
accept: Test success/failure, odd half-damage rounding, cap 30, separate sources versus one damage instance, zero damage, positive-HP unconsciousness, incapacitation and death, and no resurrection of effects on healing/waking.

Expose a narrow trusted event adapter with integration fixtures; #269 owns condition acquisition and all other condition consequences. Do not implement sleep spells, dying/death-save systems or general conditions here.
issues.exclusions: No duplicated #269 condition engine, #272 interrupted-rest flow, War Caster, concentration immunity or class exceptions.

issues.title: Resolve Acid Arrow initial damage and one durable next-turn end tick
issues.fixture: An isolated authorized level-three Wizard fixture casts level-two Acid Arrow on one known opponent, with deterministic hit and miss cases and an end-of-next-target-turn receipt.
issues.targets: One explicit known target within 90 feet with authoritative cover/path facts. Use a validated stored caster fixture; no new build creation or entitlement from catalogue data.
issues.cost: Magic action, one level-two slot, V/S/M availability. Hit: ranged spell attack, 4d4 Acid now and 2d4 at end of target’s next turn; miss: half initial damage only.
issues.timing: Instantaneous spell with one delayed damage event, not a concentration duration. Durable event identity includes cast, target, due turn and phase. Trigger once at target turn end; never caster turn, preview, wall time or reload.
accept: Use isolated validated higher-level fixture only until the exact Wizard advancement child from #332 supplies production eligibility; keep production discovery unavailable and document this boundary.
Persist initial roll/hit/miss, scheduled tick, dice, damage and turn cursor atomically. Hit schedules exactly one tick; miss schedules none. Reject unsupported slot levels and unknown turn ownership.
issues.exclusions: No upcasting, generic Wizard unlock, area/entry/start triggers, automatic combat termination rules for pending effects or free-text casting. Unknown post-encounter timing stays unavailable with an explicit reason.

issues.title: Dispel level-three-or-lower spells on one explicit creature
issues.fixture: An isolated authorized level-five Cleric fixture uses level-three Dispel Magic on a known creature carrying Shield of Faith and Bless from independent casters.
issues.targets: One known creature within 120 feet and clear path; end every qualifying ongoing spell on that target. A multi-recipient cast loses only the targeted recipient link, not other recipients.
issues.cost: Magic action, one level-three slot, V/S. Automatic ending for ongoing spells level three or lower; no ability check for these spells.
issues.timing: Commit action cost, exact affected spell/link IDs and history together. Distinguish ending the target’s spell effect from ending its caster’s unrelated concentration.
accept: Test several qualifying spells, suppressed same-name effects, unrelated targets/casters, no eligible spells (legal cast still costs), reload and exact removal once.

Reject unknown spell levels, level-four-or-higher effects and object/magical-effect targets with an explicit unsupported reason until the bounded follow-up decides them. Isolated authorized fixture only; production eligibility requires exact #323 advancement child, not decision closure.
issues.exclusions: No general antimagic, curses, nonspell magic-item removal, object/area targeting, higher-level checks/upcasting or automatic class advancement.

issues.title: Persist one Counterspell reaction window around Cure Wounds casting
issues.fixture: A prepared Cleric attempts the existing level-one Cure Wounds self cast while one explicitly known authorized NPC Counterspell caster has a reaction and level-three slot.
issues.targets: One visible known casting creature within 60 feet, with V/S/M casting observable and clear path. Use an isolated trusted NPC fixture, not a general monster caster entitlement.
issues.cost: Counterspell: one Reaction, one level-three slot, S. Target Constitution save against reactor’s spell DC. Failure wastes target’s casting action/Bonus Action/Reaction but does not expend its spell slot; success permits original cast once.
issues.timing: Suspend before original spell resolves or spends its slot; persist casting attempt and trigger identity plus actor’s spent casting time. Explicit react/decline and stale confirmation. Concentration replacement starts when casting starts, even if interrupted.
accept: Test failed and successful saves, decline, unavailable reaction, no components, unseen/foreign/out-of-range trigger, stale pending attempt, crash/reconnect before and after decision and duplicate confirmation.

Persist original attempt, reaction cost, save and resume/cancel outcome atomically. If the target fails its Constitution save, the interrupted spell never heals and never spends the target slot; if the target succeeds, the original spell resolves and heals once. Existing opportunity-reaction flow remains bounded and intact.
issues.exclusions: No 2014 ability-check or automatic-level Counterspell, nested counter-counterspell, multiplayer priority, item/free-use refunds, new NPC spell AI, general Wizard builds or player discovery.

issues.title: Split Heroism start-turn and Spirit Guardians entry/end timing fixtures
issues.fixture: Source decision contrasting Heroism start-turn temporary HP with Spirit Guardians moving-Emanation entry, creature entry and target-turn-end once-per-turn saving throws.
issues.targets: Only Heroism’s touched willing recipient and Spirit Guardians’ declared exclusions/known creatures in a 15-foot Emanation. Resolve spatial facts before proposing runtime tests.
issues.cost: Record Heroism Action/level-one slot/V/S/concentration minute and Spirit Guardians Action/level-three slot/V/S/M/concentration ten minutes; do not add executable entitlement.
issues.timing: One working session. Determine turn identity, phase, spatial revision and per-turn deduplication; Spirit Guardians is not a start-turn damage trigger.
accept: Publish separate one-PR implementation children for Heroism start-turn refresh and Spirit Guardians Emanation triggers; name exact temporary-HP, movement/area, catalogue and class eligibility prerequisite issues, reusing #272/#277 ownership.

Wire every terminal implementation child directly to both #279/#280 before closing this spike; read back parent #193 and all native prerequisites. Record ambiguous simultaneous-event ordering rather than inventing a universal scheduler.
issues.exclusions: No all-spell scheduler, unrelated conditions, summons, environmental simulation or implementation in the decision PR.

issues.title: Split Dispel Magic higher-level checks and object/effect targeting
issues.fixture: Source decision for one level-four spell on a creature, one object spell and one area effect; contrast nonspell item magic and multi-recipient targeting.
issues.targets: Enumerate creature/object/magical-effect identity, exact removal extent and authoritative visibility/range/clear path; do not assume dispelling one target ends every recipient.
issues.cost: Magic action/V/S/level-three slot; spellcasting ability check DC 10+each spell level for level four or higher, with automatic ending when upcast slot meets spell level.
issues.timing: One working session; establish per-spell check order, removal scope and replayable outcomes. Distinguish instantaneous consequences from ongoing spells.
accept: Publish separate bounded implementation children for higher-level checks/upcasting and object/effect targeting. Name the exact source fixture and target-removal contract for each; no guessed area ownership.

Add all terminal implementation blockers directly to #279/#280 and attach under #193 before closing. Nonspell magic stays unavailable unless an explicit source grants interaction; reuse #273 item-casting ownership.
issues.exclusions: No universal curse/antimagic removal, arbitrary item destruction or full Dispel Magic claim from the low-level creature fixture.
